personality.description: This person tends to explore new ideas eagerly, enjoy creative problem-solving, and switch between structured plans and flexible adjustments as needed. In daily habits, they are usually considerate and cooperative, often checking how others feel while also spending time thinking through possibilities and revisiting concerns that worry them. When facing moral dilemmas, they first look for a fair and compassionate solution, try to avoid hurting anyone, and may feel tension or second-guess themselves if the choice could upset harmony. In group discussions, they speak thoughtfully and politely, listen closely, and contribute imaginative points, though they may become cautious or self-conscious when disagreement or uncertainty rises.
traits: has assertively moved up the ranks into positions of leadership
prioritizes having control and authority over others
makes quick and definitive decisions, and once a decision is made it is usually final
has their own views of how tasks should be accomplished
uses reward and punishment to get people to follow their ideas
